description: Compile semantic behavior families into exact ObjectContracts. Runtime lookup remains exact by applies_to_kind; a spec never creates runtime inheritance.

foundries.reason: Person owns the only pre-existing published exact ObjectContract; Principal continuity remains separate work.
The connect owner exists, while household and connection material are adoption-created.
School composes the Institution root; it is not a new runtime semantic kind.
Executable CapabilityProgram lowering remains a separate materialization closure.
CommunityBody is receipt-materialized and the native community request owner records only a local participation request.
Project has typed material and native support/join; voting is correctly addressed to GovernanceProposal rather than Project.
Property surface/owner integration remains separate from ObjectGrammar.
Rich publication material has no verified creator action owner yet.
Provider and organization behavior binding remains unproved.
A receipt-materialized PublicationOccurrence has an exact native local-follow owner; external RSVP and attendance remain unclaimed.
Learning Opportunity is compiled downstream from typed owners and owns no canonical duplicate.
Tutor resolves Actor/provider to service/program; no Tutor silo is emitted.
Library is an Institution specialization, pending its contracts.
Club composes CommunityBody, ProgramInstance and occurrences rather than owning another social system.

behaviors.owner_note: Records support through the native governance owner. No money moves and the owner rechecks the signed-in actor.
behaviors.cannot_infer: stated support -> payment, pledge collection, settlement, or value moved

behaviors.owner_note: Records willingness through the native governance owner. It is not engagement, acceptance, or an employment contract.
behaviors.cannot_infer: an offered contribution -> engagement, acceptance, employment, or delivery

behaviors.reason: No verified Project proposal owner path is published; do not emit an ObjectContract.
The verified vote owner takes a governance proposal id, not a Project subject; proposal addressing must be proved before emission.
Settlement requires provider and metered-rate evidence, not a project id alone; do not advertise it as a Project contract.
TeamNeed is already rendered by the Project owner; this is a read projection, not an ObjectContract birth/effect.
FundingWorkPackage is already rendered by the Project/Program owners; this is a read projection, not an ObjectContract birth/effect.

behaviors.owner_note: Creates or releases a household connection only through the native institution-plane owner. The institution has not confirmed the relationship.
behaviors.cannot_infer: a household connection -> institution confirmation, access to a private plane, or disclosure to another household

behaviors.reason: No verified institution-claim owner is published; incidental WorkGraph claim code is not an institution behavior.
Adoption needs a verified authority owner and a human confirmation boundary.

behaviors.owner_note: Records one authenticated person's position through the native governance owner. The owner replaces that person's prior position for the proposal.
behaviors.cannot_infer: a vote -> a decision, membership consensus, authority to carry out an effect, or settlement

behaviors.reason: A decision owner and its authority/evidence closure remain separate from a vote tally.

behaviors.owner_note: Records one signed-in person's local participation request through the native CommunityMembership owner. It does not join an external carrier.
behaviors.cannot_infer: a local participation request -> acceptance, provider membership, external role, authority, or permission to act for a community

behaviors.reason: CommunityBody, membership, post and presence material remain unmaterialized and no post owner has been proved.
ProgramBinding lowers semantic slots, but CapabilityProgram has no populated executable carrier or native effect owner.
ProgramRequirement is existing typed read material, not a birth or effect contract.

behaviors.owner_note: Records one signed-in person's local follow of retained public event material. It does not RSVP or contact the external organizer.
behaviors.cannot_infer: a local occurrence follow -> RSVP, registration, attendance, provider membership, notice delivery, organizer authority, or an external effect

behaviors.reason: Stage/Mobilizon grammar is presentation evidence; no owner path has been verified for hosting.
Publication occurrences are not proof of an event/occurrence effect owner.

behaviors.owner_note: Records one signed-in person's private local save of an observed public service opportunity. It does not contact or apply to the provider.
behaviors.cannot_infer: a local opportunity save -> eligibility, application, referral, enrollment, provider notice, service delivery, authority, or a private provider relationship

behaviors.reason: A public 211 resource does not provide a verified referral or application owner; do not emit a request action.
Observed ServiceOffer material does not establish organization/provider action ownership.
SpatialObservation material is empty and the Property surface has not yet been joined to ObjectGrammar.
Creator publication material does not prove a creator publication effect owner; Person Note.declare remains the independently authored contract.
